sources.quote: Iota Piscis Austrini, also named Baijiu, is a solitary, blue-white hued star in the southern constellation of Piscis Austrinus.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 3.0 solar radii and 2.73 solar masses (FLAME) and 10,048 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
